description: Delete a DNS server list in two steps. Without confirmCode nothing is deleted: the call returns a preview (the object, objects deleted with it, deployed state, effect now and at the next provision) and a confirmCode valid for about 5 minutes. Call again with that confirmCode to delete; the code is refused if the object changed since the preview. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. A DNS server list used by a policy FQDN list is refused as in use. A segment delete is not checked against DNS server lists, so a list can hold a segment id that no longer exists. The delete removes it from the configuration at once. If it was deployed, the network keeps it until the deletion is provisioned from the Alkira portal. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

confirmCode.description: Code from the preview of this delete.

id.description: Id of the DNS server list, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The list_dns_server_get_* read tools and list_dns_server_create return it.

name: list_dns_server_delete
